releaseNotes:
- Fix auto-compact: POST /v1/responses/compact now addresses the provider's /compact path instead of plain /responses (7a13d40)
- Strip the client-only _compact marker before dispatch, so providers no longer reject the body with "unknown field" (7a13d40)
- Add the Require API key toggle with VansRouter-compatible settings, including allowRemoteNoApiKey (d7f0462)
- Dashboard: full-page login, header sign-out, glassmorphic combo cards
